subject: Geopolitics
title: Energy and National Security
description: A quick, practical guide to Energy and National Security.

hook.text: Japan imports 90% of its energy. A sustained supply cut would cripple its economy within weeks.

buildup.text: Energy-poor nations must maintain good relations with suppliers. Dependence limits foreign policy freedom.

discovery.text: Energy security means reliable, affordable, diverse supply.

twist.text: Even energy-rich nations face security risks.

climax.text: Energy security is never absolute. Every nation is vulnerable through supply, infrastructure, or price volatility.

punchline.text: No nation is energy secure. Some are just less exposed.

quiz.question: How does energy dependence affect a nation's foreign policy?
options: It has no effect on diplomatic decisions
It limits freedom and creates vulnerability to coercion
It always leads to military alliances
